_comment: Authored by the educational team, not by the model. Every message a student sees originates here. 'avoid_when' is a hard retrieval constraint.

strategies.name: Surface the divergent readings
strategies.goal: Make implicit differences in task understanding explicit so the group can reconcile them
strategies.appropriate_when: Confusion persists and members appear to be working from different problem definitions
strategies.avoid_when: The group has already restated the task in this phase
strategies.text: Before going further, could each of you say in one sentence what you think the group is trying to solve right now?
strategies.source: CLARA coaching guide, shared task understanding
strategies.keywords: confusion unclear task understanding goal definition divergent framing

strategies.name: Re-anchor to the challenge
strategies.goal: Reconnect implementation work to the original challenge statement
strategies.appropriate_when: Confusion appears during building and the work may have drifted from the stated challenge
strategies.avoid_when: The group is deliberately exploring a pivot they have already named
strategies.text: Which part of your original challenge statement does the piece you are building now actually address?
strategies.keywords: confusion building implementation drift alignment challenge scope

strategies.name: Name the blockage, then choose
strategies.goal: Convert diffuse frustration into a named obstacle and a next action
strategies.appropriate_when: Frustration has persisted without the group changing its approach
strategies.avoid_when: The group is already renegotiating its plan
strategies.text: It sounds like something here is stuck. What is the one obstacle you would most want removed, and what would you try next if it were?
strategies.keywords: frustration stuck blocked obstacle tension strategy change approach

strategies.name: Open the floor deliberately
strategies.goal: Redistribute participation without singling anyone out
strategies.appropriate_when: Contribution has concentrated on a subset of the group across several minutes
strategies.avoid_when: The imbalance is a deliberate division of labour the group has agreed
strategies.text: Some perspectives have not been heard for a while. Could you go round the group and each add one thing to the current idea?
strategies.source: CLARA coaching guide, participation and inclusion
strategies.keywords: participation imbalance quiet silent dominance inclusion turn taking floor

strategies.name: Make the plan explicit
strategies.goal: Turn undirected activity into a named decision with an owner
strategies.appropriate_when: Activity continues but no decision or task distribution is visible
strategies.avoid_when: The group has just agreed a plan
strategies.text: What is the next concrete thing this group needs to decide, and who is going to take it forward?
strategies.source: CLARA coaching guide, planning and task distribution
strategies.keywords: progress planning goal setting task distribution decision next step

strategies.name: Check the pace against the phase
strategies.goal: Prompt monitoring of pace and division of work late in the session
strategies.appropriate_when: Progress is low during building and the phase is running out
strategies.avoid_when: The group has already adjusted its division of work in this phase
strategies.text: Looking at where you wanted to be by now, what would you change about how the work is divided?
strategies.source: CLARA coaching guide, monitoring and pacing
strategies.keywords: progress pace monitoring division work building schedule

strategies.name: Test the disagreement
strategies.goal: Make an unresolved difference of view explicit and testable
strategies.appropriate_when: Confusion is high and appears to stem from competing positions rather than missing information
strategies.avoid_when: The group has already converged on one position
strategies.text: There seem to be two directions in play here. What would you need to find out to decide between them?
strategies.keywords: disagreement conflicting views competing positions decide evidence resolve

strategies.name: Route a decision through the group
strategies.goal: Rebuild shared ownership when one member has been carrying the work
strategies.appropriate_when: Participation has been concentrated for an extended period and disengagement is visible
strategies.avoid_when: A group-wide check has already been run recently
strategies.text: Before this is settled, could the group say whether everyone is behind the current direction?
strategies.keywords: ownership decision group agreement disengagement concentrated participation

strategies.name: Neutral status check
strategies.goal: Offer support without asserting that anything is wrong
strategies.appropriate_when: Evidence suggests difficulty but is not reliable enough to act on
strategies.text: Quick check-in: how is the group doing with the current step, and is there anything you would like help with?
strategies.keywords: check in status neutral general support offer uncertain

strategies.name: Invite a self-report
strategies.goal: Let the group characterise its own state rather than being told
strategies.appropriate_when: Upstream evidence is weak and a self-report is more reliable than inference
strategies.text: How well is the group working together at the moment, on your own reading of it?
strategies.keywords: check in collaboration self report reflection uncertain evidence
